## Description

Owns long-gamma options and dynamically trades the underlying to rebalance delta, seeking realized movement to exceed the premium/decay paid.

## Where it may fit

High realized volatility relative to implied volatility, with sufficient liquidity to rebalance at manageable costs.

## Vehicles

Options market makers, volatility-arbitrage and event-volatility books.

## Required data

Option positions and Greeks, underlying intraday prices, implied volatility, rates/dividends, bid/ask spreads and rebalance timestamps.

## Caveats

Long gamma loses theta absent sufficient realized movement; hedging costs, discrete jumps and volatility changes need realistic modeling.
